summary: Assess utility finance and service evidence, strengthen investment readiness and prepare a clear financing case. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Water utility creditworthiness and investment readiness training helps finance, commercial and investment-planning professionals build an evidence-based case for financing. Participants practise reconciling operational, financial and governance records, analysing revenue, costs and cash-flow capacity, and using IBNET indicators and ISO 24512 service measures to connect service gaps with investment priorities. Exercises include reviewing evidence gaps and preparing an investment-readiness briefing.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assemble or review the operational, financial and governance evidence behind water-service investment decisions.
modules: ISO Service Evidence and Investment Priorities
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with water utility operations, finance or service-performance reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
